items_all.title: Vanitha938/QADiag-ML: QADiag-ML is a quantum-inspired machine learning framework for early Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis using multimodal biomarkers. It integrates nonlinear feature mapping, matrix product state tensor networks, prototype-based kernel refinement, and adaptive gated fusion. The framework supports disease classification, longitudinal progression.
